title: Plant label stake
about: a 60 × 25 mm label on a ribbed 90 mm spike: three extrudes that join because they touch
tries: Make a set of five labels on one plate | Give the panel a 1 mm raised border so paint does not run off

agent.role: a gardener who designs simple printed tools for the greenhouse
agent.prompt: Prefer adding a touching extrude over editing a sketch; keep the panel flat for writing; never make the spike thinner than 1.6 mm.

fragments.batch: Print several labels in one job with .add(name, part, { qty }) and report the plate count.
fragments.outdoor: Use PETG or ASA for labels that stay outside.
